description: This file contains functions for upgrading Netgear Orbi devices with scripts that handle flashing kernel and root filesystem images, mounting loop devices, formatting filesystems, and performing system reboots as part of an upgrade process.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_netgear_orbi_upgrade
methods.description: Main upgrade function that checks prerequisites, finds kernel and root partitions, and triggers the flashing process.

methods.name: netgear_orbi_do_flash
methods.description: Performs the actual flashing of kernel and root filesystem images, creates loop devices, formats new filesystems, and handles backup restoration.
